parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: 设备的主机名，用于标识网络中的设备。

set firewall family inet6 filter 3500 te.template: set firewall family inet6 filter [parameter1] term [parameter2] from source-address [parameter3]
set firewall family inet6 filter 3500 te.command: set firewall family inet6 filter 3500 term 1 from source-address 2001:DB8:2::/64
set firewall family inet6 filter 3500 te.explanation: 配置IPv6防火墙过滤器的源地址条件。

set firewall family inet6 filter 3500 te.template: set firewall family inet6 filter [parameter1] term [parameter2] then [parameter3]
set firewall family inet6 filter 3500 te.command: set firewall family inet6 filter 3500 term 1 then accept
set firewall family inet6 filter 3500 te.explanation: 配置IPv6防火墙过滤器的动作。

parameters.name: action
parameters.explanation: 匹配条件后的动作，例如accept。

set firewall family inet6 filter p1 term.template: set firewall family inet6 filter [parameter1] term [parameter2] from source-address [parameter3]

set firewall family inet6 filter p1 term.explanation: 配置IPv6防火墙过滤器的源地址条件。

set routing-instances DS-Lite routing-op.explanation: 配置路由实例的路由器ID。

parameters.name: router-id
parameters.explanation: 路由器的ID，用于标识路由器。

set interfaces ge-0/0/2 unit 0 family in.explanation: 配置接口的IPv6输入过滤器。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。
